summary: Lando Norris won the Miami Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 3.8s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Esteban Ocon made the biggest climb, from P16 to P11.
Kimi Antonelli had a day to forget, dropping from P2 to P6.
The stewards penalised ANT (5 second time penalty).
There were 1 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 0 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 7 points over George Russell.
